title: 'Entitled' Woman Crashes Her Car Into Neighbor House Then Tries To Deny It #news #police #shorts
description:
#news #police #arrest

On October 22, 2022. Homeowners called the police about a vehicle that crashed into their house. The lady left the scene before the officers arrived &  homeowners said that she appeared to be intoxicated. She was later caught trying to flee the scene in her dad's vehicle.
